'''Kat Dowani''' was an [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] serving on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. There she owned a small shop where she bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics.<ref name="TOR" />
